contract: CP-01: Responsibility Mapping and Survivor Selection

epistemic_representation.deficit: Dual epistemic taxonomy (9 ledger statuses vs 9 research compiler categories) with parallel storage (v11_warrants vs agency_claims).
epistemic_representation.resolution: Fold contracts/epistemic_ledger.py into kageyoni/research_compiler/claims.py. Compose Warrant to point directly to ClaimNode in ClaimGraph.

runtime_governance_and_gates.deficit: Potential conflation between build/release qualification gates (G0-G9) and live runtime operation lifecycle (DECLARED -> PREPARED -> ASSESSED -> AUTHORIZED -> COMPLETED).
runtime_governance_and_gates.resolution: Keep ProtectedOperations as the single runtime domain mediator. Retain GateRunner strictly for external build qualification. Situation operations route through v11_adapter.

invalidation_propagation.deficit: Relies on JSON string substring matching (cid in json_str) to identify affected packages and projects.
invalidation_propagation.resolution: Refactor to use relational graph edges in ClaimGraph and foreign key tables, deprecating substring matching.

situation_memory_and_transfer.deficit: SituationMemoryStore performs in-memory linear scan over all memories for retrieval; qualify_transfer performs ad-hoc checks bypassing canonical Transfers service.
situation_memory_and_transfer.resolution: Compose situation transfer through kageyoni/intelligence/transfer.py:Transfers. Index situation memory queries in SQLite.

transaction_and_persistence.deficit: Multiple modules manage individual raw SQLite cursor transactions and commits independently, risking torn state across complex multi-table mutations.
transaction_and_persistence.resolution: Introduce UnitOfWork pattern in CP-04 to coordinate atomic multi-table mutations under engine custody.
